SELECT c.contract_id, c.PROJECT_ID, c.contract_number, h.manage_hd_id, c.contract_name, ( SELECT HBM.BP_NAME FROM HLS_BP_MASTER HBM WHERE c.tenant_id = HBM.BP_ID ) BP_NAME, h.manage_number, (Select scvb.meaning As value_name From sys_code_value_b scvb, sys_code_b scb Where scb.code = 'PRJ.MARGIN_PAYMENT_METHOD' And scb.code_id = scvb.code_id And scvb.enabled_flag = 'Y' and scvb.value = h.AFTER_CHANGE_WAY) AFTER_CHANGE_WAY_N, (Select scvb.meaning As value_name From sys_code_value_b scvb, sys_code_b scb Where scb.code = 'PRJ.MARGIN_PAYMENT_METHOD' And scb.code_id = scvb.code_id And scvb.enabled_flag = 'Y' and scvb.value = c.deposit_deduction) deposit_deduction_n, h.description FROM con_contract c,CSH_DEPOSIT_manage_hd h
1=1 and h.contract_id = c.ref_contract_id and h.handling_method = '1' AND c.contract_id = (select max(ct.contract_id) from CSH_DEPOSIT_manage_hd hh,con_contract ct where hh.contract_id = ct.ref_contract_id and hh.manage_hd_id = #{manageHdId} and ct.data_class = 'HISTORY')

SELECT c.times, (select hci.description from hls_cashflow_item hci where hci.cf_item = c.cf_item)cf_item_n, c.due_date, c.due_amount, c.principal, c.net_principal, c.interest, --手续费 t.contract_id, c.cashflow_id, (select q.lease_charge from prj_quotation q where q.quotation_id = c.quotation_id )lease_charge, (select q.deposit from prj_quotation q where q.quotation_id = c.quotation_id )deposit,
(select q.before_rent_total from prj_quotation q where q.quotation_id = c.quotation_id )before_rent_total, (select q.down_payment from prj_quotation q where q.quotation_id = c.quotation_id )down_payment, decode(c.cf_item,52,(Select scvb.meaning As value_name From sys_code_value_b scvb, sys_code_b scb Where scb.code = 'PRJ.MARGIN_PAYMENT_METHOD' And scb.code_id = scvb.code_id And scvb.enabled_flag = 'Y' and scvb.value = t.deposit_deduction)) deposit_deduction_n
FROM CSH_DEPOSIT_manage_hd h,con_contract t, con_contract_cashflow c
t.contract_id = c.contract_id AND c.cf_status != 'BLOCK' AND t.data_class = 'NORMAL' and h.contract_id = c.contract_id and h.manage_hd_id = #{manageHdId,jdbcType=DECIMAL}
order by c.times
